title: A ticket for a session that was paid for
description: A fictional operator issued a charge for no valid payment. The sample receipt records payment for the same vehicle, car park and time.

facts.narrative: This is a fictional demonstration. I parked at Willow Yard, London on 20 October 2026. I paid £6 at 09:55 for vehicle DEMO123, covering 10:00 to 13:00. The notice alleges no valid payment at 11:15. The attached receipt has the same vehicle and location. I want the operator to check its payment records. No cancellation or refund has happened.

assessment.summary: The sample receipt records payment for the same vehicle and location from 10:00 to 13:00, covering the notice time of 11:15. That gives the driver a factual reason to ask the operator to review its records. It does not establish that the charge has been cancelled.

grounds.title: Payment appears to cover the alleged contravention
grounds.explanation: Compare DEMO123, Willow Yard and the paid session against the notice. Ask the operator to reconcile the matching receipt with its payment records.

missing_evidence: The operator's underlying payment and enforcement records have not been supplied.
risks: Check the issuer's actual challenge instructions and discount terms. This fictional example does not establish a legal entitlement to cancellation.

SAMPLE DRAFT — FICTIONAL DEMONSTRATION ONLY

To Willow Yard Parking (fictional),

Re: parking charge DEMO-001, vehicle DEMO123

Please review this charge, which alleges no valid payment at Willow Yard, London on 20 October 2026 at 11:15.

I paid £6 at 09:55 for vehicle DEMO123. My attached receipt records a parking session at the same location from 10:00 to 13:00, covering the time stated on the notice.

Please check the receipt against your payment and enforcement records and cancel the charge if you confirm that it was issued in error. If you maintain the charge, please explain the discrepancy and provide the records relied upon.

Yours faithfully,
[Your name]
